api_endpoints.description: Send a 6-digit SMS OTP to the supplied Uzbek phone number via Eskiz/Playmobile aggregator. Server enforces 60s resend cooldown and 5/hour per-MSISDN ceiling.
Pre-flight check to tell the client whether this MSISDN already has an account (controls signup vs login copy on the next screen).

native_integration_details: expo-localization: read Localization.locale and Localization.timezone to fill client.locale / timezone headers.

expo-application: read Application.nativeApplicationVersion (app_version), Application.nativeBuildVersion (build_number), Application.getIosIdForVendorAsync()/Application.getAndroidId() for install_id seed.
expo-device: read Device.modelId (ios) / Device.modelName (android) for device_model and Device.osVersion.
react-native-otp-entry: 6-cell input wired to the response.otp_length value.
react-native-google-recaptcha-v2 (or expo-recaptcha-v3): produce captcha_token on Android release builds; web on iOS via WebView fallback.
Headers attached by api-client interceptor: X-Mator-Client-Platform, X-Mator-App-Version, X-Mator-Build, X-Mator-Install-Id, Accept-Language.

api_endpoints.description: Exchange the 6-digit OTP for an access/refresh token pair. On success the response also indicates whether MyID verification is required before the user can transact.
Resend OTP using the prior request_id. Subject to the same 60s/5-per-hour ceiling enforced server-side.

native_integration_details: expo-notifications: const { data: expoPushToken } = await Notifications.getExpoPushTokenAsync({ projectId: Constants.expoConfig.extra.eas.projectId }); send the raw string in expo_push_token.
expo-notifications: getDevicePushTokenAsync() returns the native APNs/FCM token — send via fcm_token / apns_token for direct-provider fallback.
expo-secure-store: write access_token + refresh_token under keys 'mator.access' / 'mator.refresh' with WHEN_UNLOCKED_THIS_DEVICE_ONLY.
@react-native-async-storage/async-storage: cache user payload at key 'mator.user.cache' for cold-start UI before refresh.
expo-router: router.replace(response.next_screen === 'AuthMyIdConsentScreen' ? '/(auth)/myid-consent' : '/(tabs)') based on requires_myid_verification.
API client: on 401, call POST /v1/auth/token/refresh with refresh_token; on 403 myid_required, redirect to /(auth)/myid-consent.

api_endpoints.description: Create a MyID verification session and return the OAuth2 authorize URL (myid.uz) the client must open in a WebView/AuthSession. Includes state and PKCE challenge.
Backend exchanges the MyID authorization code for an identity payload (passport, PINFL, biometric verdict) and links it to the current Mator user.
Poll-able status used by the client while the WebView is open and again on resume.

native_integration_details: expo-auth-session: AuthSession.useAuthRequest({ clientId: 'mator-prod', redirectUri: 'mator://auth/myid/callback', scopes, responseType: 'code', usePKCE: true }) — proxy.startAsync(authorize_url) to launch the system WebView.
Universal links / deep links: configure scheme 'mator' in app.json (expo.scheme = 'mator') and iOS associatedDomains 'applinks:mator.uz', Android intentFilters for https://mator.uz/auth/myid.
expo-web-browser: WebBrowser.openAuthSessionAsync(authorize_url, redirectUri) on the path that closes the in-app browser as soon as the redirect fires.
expo-crypto: derive PKCE code_verifier and SHA-256 code_challenge via Crypto.digestStringAsync(SHA256, verifier, { encoding: BASE64 }) — only the verifier is sent on callback exchange.
expo-linking: Linking.addEventListener('url', ({ url }) => handleMyIdCallback(url)) to catch the redirect when the user returns from MyID.
react-native-app-state: useAppState() to retry GET /v1/auth/myid/status when foregrounded mid-flow.

api_endpoints.description: List all vehicles for the signed-in user, ordered by is_primary DESC, created_at DESC.
Create a new vehicle from the 3-step wizard (make/model/year + trim/engine + registration).
Update mileage, nickname, primary flag, or registration data.
Soft-delete a vehicle (retained for compatibility history).

native_integration_details: expo-gl + three / @react-three/fiber-native: load model_3d.glb_url through GLTFLoader; cache via expo-file-system FileSystem.downloadAsync to documentDirectory + 'models/' + checksum_sha256 + '.glb' for offline reuse.
expo-file-system: FileSystem.getInfoAsync(localPath) gates re-download; checksum_sha256 validated against FileSystem.readAsStringAsync hashing via expo-crypto.
react-native-mmkv: store the active vehicle_id at 'mator.garage.primary_id' for synchronous read on cold start (used by AI Advisor compatibility filters).
@tanstack/react-query: queryKey ['garage','list'] invalidated on create/patch/delete via queryClient.invalidateQueries.
expo-image: render brand logo via AppImage source={ uri: vehicle.make.logo_url } with cachePolicy='memory-disk'.
Pre-warm queue: kick off prefetch of model_3d.glb_url on first GarageList render so VehicleDetail opens with a hot cache.

api_endpoints.description: Return mechanics (masters) within a radius of the user location, ordered by distance ascending. Supports filtering by specialization, rating, vehicle make compatibility, and open-now.
Return service stations (STO) within radius. Same filter contract as /masters/nearby plus a 'service_types' filter.
Full master profile: portfolio, certifications, reviews summary, working hours, services with UZS pricing.
Create a booking slot. Returns a hold token valid for 5 minutes pending checkout.

native_integration_details: react-native-maps: <MapView provider={PROVIDER_GOOGLE} region={{ latitude: center_lat, longitude: center_lng, latitudeDelta: 0.04, longitudeDelta: 0.04 }} onRegionChangeComplete={debounced refetch with new viewport_min/max bounds}.
react-native-maps Marker: marker per result.id with coordinate={{ latitude: result.geo.lat, longitude: result.geo.lng }}; pick custom <Marker.Image> per result.type (master vs sto).
react-native-map-clustering OR react-native-maps Marker tracksViewChanges=false: render cluster_hints as soft markers labelled with count to reduce DOM weight.
expo-location: Location.requestForegroundPermissionsAsync then Location.getCurrentPositionAsync({ accuracy: Location.Accuracy.Balanced }) to seed center_lat/center_lng on mount.
expo-location: Location.watchPositionAsync only while the screen is focused (useIsFocused) to avoid battery drain.
@react-navigation deep-link param: routes to '/(tabs)/(explore)/master-detail/[id]' carry the master_id; viewport state stashed in search-ui.context for back-restoration.
expo-linking: tap on contact.phone_e164 → Linking.openURL('tel:' + phone); tap Telegram → Linking.openURL('https://t.me/' + telegram_username.replace('@','')).

api_endpoints.description: Faceted catalog list. Server-side filtering by vehicle_id projects a per-row compatibility flag so the UI can render 'Fits your car' badges without a second roundtrip.
Full part detail: media, specs, OEM cross-references, seller offers ranked by price + ETA.
Explicit compatibility matrix for the given part against vehicle_id; returns trims/engines/years that match and a confidence rating.

native_integration_details: @tanstack/react-query: useInfiniteQuery with queryKey ['catalog', vehicle_id, filtersHash], getNextPageParam = lastPage.next_page.
expo-image: prefetch items[].images[0] for the visible window via Image.prefetch on FlashList onViewableItemsChanged.
react-native-mmkv: read 'mator.garage.primary_id' to auto-populate vehicle_id filter; the absence of it disables the 'Fits your car' chip.
expo-haptics: Haptics.selectionAsync on filter chip toggle and Haptics.notificationAsync(Success) when the 'fits' badge is tapped to add to cart.
shopify/flash-list FlashList: estimatedItemSize=320, keyExtractor=id, disableAutoLayout for perf on the long catalog list.

api_endpoints.description: Create a chat session bound to a vehicle context. The session_id is what the UI persists across cold starts.
Send a user message; server streams assistant tokens via SSE. Non-streaming mode returns the full message object.
Restore the message log on cold start.

native_integration_details: react-native-sse OR react-native-event-source: open EventSource(`${API}/v1/ai/sessions/${id}/messages`, { headers: { Authorization, Accept: 'text/event-stream' } }) and append chunks to message buffer.
expo-image-picker: ImagePicker.launchImageLibraryAsync({ mediaTypes: ImagePicker.MediaTypeOptions.Images, quality: 0.85 }) -> upload to /v1/uploads -> attach returned url in attachments[].
expo-haptics: Haptics.impactAsync(Light) on first streamed token, Haptics.notificationAsync(Success) on stream end.
@tanstack/react-query: queryKey ['ai','session',id]; on createSession success, prefetch session_restore_response so cold-start is instant.
ai-chat-composer.tsx: bind vehicle_context.engine into the composer hint chip 'Asking about: Chevrolet Cobalt 2019 (B15D2 1.5L)'; if no vehicle_id, render the picker sheet first.
Background-safe: SSE connection closed via EventSource.close() on AppState change to 'background'; reopens on focus and resumes via Last-Event-ID header.

api_endpoints.description: Create an order from a cart snapshot. Server validates stock, computes UZS totals (subtotal + delivery + service fee), and returns an order in 'pending_payment'.
Create a Payme invoice for the order and return the deep-link URL the client opens. Server holds the order in 'pending_payment' until Payme posts the result to the merchant webhook.
Same contract for Click. Returns the click:// deep link plus a fallback https://my.click.uz URL for browser/WebView.
Polling endpoint. The client polls after returning from the payment app to confirm status.
Source of truth for order status. Updated by the payment provider webhook.

native_integration_details: expo-linking: const supported = await Linking.canOpenURL(deep_link); if (supported) Linking.openURL(deep_link); else Linking.openURL(https_fallback) — pattern reused for both payme:// and click://.
expo-web-browser: WebBrowser.openBrowserAsync(https_fallback, { presentationStyle: 'pageSheet' }) for the fallback on iOS so the user can come back via swipe-down.
expo-router: register catch-all handler at app/payments/payme/return.tsx and app/payments/click/return.tsx that read the return URL params and call GET /v1/payments/{payment_id}.
react-native-app-state: on AppState 'active' after a foreground hop to the payment app, refetch GET /v1/orders/{order_id} every 2s (max 30s) until status leaves 'pending_payment'.
expo-secure-store: never store raw card data; only the payment_id is persisted at key 'mator.payment.last_id' for cold-start recovery.
expo-notifications: backend will also push a 'payment_paid' data-only notification so the client can short-circuit polling even when AppState wakes late.

api_endpoints.description: Bind the Expo push token (and native FCM/APNs tokens) to the signed-in user + device fingerprint. Re-called on token refresh.
Unbind on sign-out so the user no longer receives this device's notifications.
Update per-topic toggles (orders, ai_replies, master_messages, marketing).
In-app inbox list, used by NotificationsScreen as the source of truth — push payloads are routing hints, not the storage layer.
Mark a notification as read.

native_integration_details: expo-notifications: Notifications.setNotificationHandler({ handleNotification: async () => ({ shouldShowBanner: true, shouldPlaySound: true, shouldSetBadge: true }) }) registered at app/_layout.tsx top-level.

expo-notifications: const token = (await Notifications.getExpoPushTokenAsync({ projectId: Constants.expoConfig.extra.eas.projectId })).data — send via /v1/devices/register at first-launch and on Notifications.addPushTokenListener (token refresh).

Android channels: Notifications.setNotificationChannelAsync('orders', { name: 'Buyurtmalar', importance: AndroidImportance.HIGH, sound: 'default' }) and an 'ai_replies' channel with importance DEFAULT.
iOS categories: Notifications.setNotificationCategoryAsync('order_paid', [{ identifier: 'view', buttonTitle: 'Ko\'rish', options: { opensAppToForeground: true } }]).

Background data-only: Notifications.addNotificationReceivedListener for foreground; Notifications.addNotificationResponseReceivedListener for tap (works for background AND killed when Notifications.getLastNotificationResponseAsync() is also checked on cold start).

expo-router deep linking: const path = routing_matrix.find(r => r.type === data.type).expo_router_path; router.push({ pathname: path, params: pick(data, r.params) }) — use routing_matrix as the single source of truth so backend can extend without a client release.

Cold-start guard: in app/_layout.tsx run const last = await Notifications.getLastNotificationResponseAsync(); if present and not yet processed (compare data.notification_id against MMKV 'mator.push.last_handled'), route once on mount.

Permissions: Notifications.requestPermissionsAsync({ ios: { allowAlert: true, allowBadge: true, allowSound: true, allowAnnouncements: false } }) deferred to after the first sign-in success (not on cold start) to avoid burning the prompt.
